## Migration Details

### What Changed in Migrated Skills

1. **Frontmatter**: Added `od.outputFormat: file-edit` to each skill's `od` section
2. **Body**: Replaced all `<artifact>` tags with `<file-edit>` tags (with appropriate file paths)
3. **Body**: Replaced references to "HTML artifact" with "React component file set"
4. **Body**: Replaced references to "standalone HTML" with "React component + CSS module"
5. **Body**: Updated output examples from single HTML artifact to React component + CSS module + types as separate `<file-edit>` blocks
6. **Body**: Added `<!-- MIGRATED: output changed from <artifact> to <file-edit> -->` comment

### What Changed in Legacy Skills

1. **Frontmatter**: Added `od.outputFormat: artifact` to each skill's `od` section
2. **Frontmatter**: Changed `od.mode` to `design` (from `deck`, `template`, `prototype`, or `utility`)
3. **Body**: Added `<!-- LEGACY: retained for design mode compatibility -->` comment

### What Changed in Deprecated Skills

1. **Frontmatter**: Added `od.deprecated: true` to each skill's `od` section
2. **Frontmatter**: Added `od.deprecatedReason` with a clear explanation
3. **Body**: Added `<!-- DEPRECATED: not relevant for Tauri + React stack -->` comment

### New Frontmatter Field: `od.outputFormat`

| Value | Meaning |
|-------|---------|
| `file-edit` | Skill outputs source code files via `<file-edit>` tags (app development mode) |
| `artifact` | Skill outputs standalone HTML via `<artifact>` tags (design mode) |
| *(absent)* | Not yet migrated — needs manual review |

### Output Format Comparison

**Before (artifact format)**:
```
<artifact identifier="faq-page" type="text/html" title="FAQ Page">
<!doctype html>
<html>...</html>
</artifact>
```

**After (file-edit format)**:
```
<file-edit path="src/components/faq-page/FaqPage.tsx">
// React component code
</file-edit>

<file-edit path="src/components/faq-page/FaqPage.module.css">
/* CSS module styles */
</file-edit>

<file-edit path="src/components/faq-page/types.ts">
// TypeScript interfaces
</file-edit>
```
